article.story: Ohio (1-1) at South Alabama (1-1), Sept. 19 at 7 p.m. EDT. Opening Line: South Alabama by 3.5. Against the spread: South Alabama 2-0, Ohio 1-1. South Alabama ranks 30th on offense, converting on 51.5% of third downs. South Alabama is 24th in the FBS with a +2 turnover margin. Ohio ranks 7th in the FBS averaging 27.5 penalty yards per game. South Alabama is 87th in FBS in red zone defense, allowing opponents to score on 100.0% of trips. Ohio's red zone offense ranks 1st, scoring on 100.0% of red zone opportunities. Ohio ranks 65th in the FBS with an average time of possession of 30:28, compared to South Alabama's 1st-ranked average of 38:54. Davenport passed for 296 yards on 22-of-32 attempts (68.8%) with two touchdowns and no interceptions. He also carried the ball nine times for 50 yards. Martin had 73 rushing yards on 15 carries and one touchdown, adding four receptions for 32 yards. Jenkins had nine receptions for 119 yards and one touchdown. Ohio won 29-27 over Jacksonville State on Sept. 12. Matt Vezza led Ohio with 80 yards on 10-of-12 passing (83.3%) for one touchdown and no interceptions. He also carried the ball 12 times for 67 yards. Brune had 66 rushing yards on 18 carries, adding two receptions for 23 yards. Neer had four receptions for 38 yards and one touchdown.
